summary: Tavia Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting issuance of an unsecured promissory note of up to $540,000 to its sponsor to fund monthly contributions of up to $60,000 to its trust account. The note is non-interest-bearing, payable upon consummation of an initial business combination or winding-up. This is a routine financing arrangement to extend the SPAC's timeline, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or management change is involved. The filing is a standard SPAC administrative update; the category is None.
